entities.name: Kenji Hatanaka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Major Kenji Hatanaka  was a Japanese military officer and one of the chief conspirators in the Kyūjō incident, a plot to seize the Imperial Palace and to prevent the broadcast of Emperor Hirohito's surrender speech to mark the end of World War II.
